rows.role_title: رئيس مجلس الشورى — Chairman of the Shura Council
rows.text: Release dated June 5, 2001: the Council 'held the first session of its third four-year term in Riyadh today under the chairmanship of Shaikh Muhammad bin Jubair, whose term of office has been renewed', with the newly appointed Deputy Chairman Dr. Bakri Shatta.

bounded_scope: Chair observations for CLAUDE-C01-25 only (sa_shura_chair and sa_succession_chair). Appointment orders, stated effective days, stated first days in office, oaths, council-formation orders, term starts and openings, acting presiding, deaths, translations, republications and in-office attestations stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row.
